facts.text: Snow left South Lake (9,600 ft) 38 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: South Lake
evidence.detail: left April 8; earlier seasons: June 27 (2023), May 16 (2024), May 11 (2025)

facts.text: At South Lake (9,600 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 2.4 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: South Lake
evidence.detail: 2.4 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 41.2 in (2023), 13.9 in (2024), 11.5 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 31 and August 16, carried from the melt-out date at Blackcap Basin (10,180 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Blackcap Basin
evidence.detail: melted out May 30, 2,267 ft below the pass; points to May 31 to August 16
